metadata.title: Setup Test Environment
metadata.purposeAndUsage: Set up output directory, load configuration, verify AWS SSO session, and confirm target environment before test execution.

output.description: Output directory created, config loaded, AWS session verified, environment confirmed by user

specificActions: Load app config-map for AWS service endpoints
Verify AWS SSO session and account ID
bestPractices: All AWS CLI commands must include --profile and --region
Account ID mismatch = abort immediately with clear error
If config.json missing, instruct user to copy from config.example.json
If app config-map not found, abort with error showing expected path

substeps.name: Create output directory
substeps.description: Set up directory for test evidence and reports

substeps.name: Load config
actions: If missing, instruct user to copy from config.example.json and stop
Resolve target environment: use --env if provided, otherwise defaultEnvironment

substeps.name: Verify AWS SSO session
substeps.description: Ensure AWS session is active and correct
actions: If fails: run aws sso login --profile {awsProfile}
Compare Account field against awsAccountId — if mismatch, ABORT with clear error

substeps.name: Confirm environment with user
substeps.description: Display resolved environment and get confirmation
actions: Display: environment, baseUrl, awsProfile, awsAccountId, awsRegion, s3Bucket, queues, coralogix, account holder service
Ask user to confirm via AskQuestion
If user declines, abort the run

substeps.name: Store config in memory
actions: Store all resolved config values in memory for subsequent steps

substeps.name: End-Step: Compliance Check
actions: Output: '✓ Step completed in compliance with operating principles'

flow.description: Create output dir → load config → load app config-map → verify AWS → confirm with user → store
